info.name: KhmeRiel Omnichannel MIS & POS Engine — Master RBAC API Collection (118 Endpoints)
info.description:
Complete, exhaustive REST API collection for KhmeRiel (Store Stock MIS & Point-of-Sale Engine) with 100% RBAC role-level classification.

Structure:
1. Level 0: Public / Storefront (No Auth)
2. Level 1: Cashier & POS Operator (CASHIER / STAFF)
3. Level 2: Inventory & Warehouse Manager (MANAGER)
4. Level 3: Executive Administrator & Auditor (ADMIN / SUPERADMIN)

item.name: 1. Public & Customer Storefront (No Auth)
item.description: Storefront browsing, category taxonomy, live stock queries, customer reviews, KHQR generation, and audio feedback.
